text: Now friendship may be thus defined: a complete accord on all subjects human and divine, joined with mutual goodwill and affection. And with the exception of wisdom, I am inclined to think nothing better than this has been given to man by the immortal gods.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
